'''Dragoneye''' was a famed [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. Using scavenged parts from other weapons, he developed his own [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], the [[Dragoneye Reaper]]. As Dragoneye became more and more infamous among the criminal underworld, the popularity of his weapon grew too. Soon many bounty hunters used their own versions of this weapon.

==Behind the scenes==
Dragoneye is mentioned in the description of the [[C-10 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|C-10 "Dragoneye Reaper" pistol]] that can be looted from killed [[Kerritamba Village|Kerritamba Wookiees]] in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
